subject: Borealis VPC: sudden throughput collapse and 5xx spike — requesting exec sync
messages:
From: Ethan Li <ethan.li@borealis.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@borealis.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Spike in 5xx and throughput collapse on our VPC - urgent

Hi Lauren,

We started seeing a sharp throughput drop and a lot of 5xxs on our private VPC deployment around 13:40 PST. Error rates jumped from ~0.3% to ~6% and p95 latency doubled. This is impacting inference for our production search rerank pipeline (model: redwood/optima-7b-q4).

Quick details:
- Region: us-west-2 (private cluster behind our VPC peering)
- Symptoms: sustained 503/504s and occasional OOM-ish worker restarts; service falls back to warm cached instances but overall capacity is ~60% of expected.
- Impact: Several downstream services are throttling; customers are seeing timeouts.

We've attached a trimmed error log (borealis_error_snippet.txt) showing repeated "kernel launch failed" traces and repeated Redis prefix-miss spikes. Can your oncall/SRE team triage? We're happy to grant temporary elevated access if it helps.

Sophie/ops: any internal notes to add?

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Li
Head of Platform Engineering, Borealis AI
ops@borealis.ai

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Ethan Li <ethan.li@borealis.ai>
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@borealis.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 14:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx and throughput collapse on our VPC - urgent

Ethan — thanks for the quick heads up and the log snippet. I’m escalating to SRE and our solutions team; looping in the folks above.

Immediate plan:
1) Jonas & Aditya: can you run a short health sweep (kernel/runtime traces + node-level OOMs) and confirm whether this is a model-kernel regression or infra saturation?
2) Marissa & Vanessa: I’ll coordinate comms/commitments to Borealis (ETA and any credits). If we need temporary capacity bump or RDP restart windows, please propose times.
3) Ethan/Sophie: please share the Grafana short-link and any recent deploys to client-side infra in the last 24h.

We’ll aim for an exec-level 15 minute huddle in 30 min if the initial triage looks like a service-impacting regression.

— Lauren Bishop
Sr. Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 14:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx and throughput collapse on our VPC - urgent

Lauren / team — quick triage notes after checking the customer logs and node telemetry (pushed to the incident board):

Findings (first pass):
- Multiple inference workers reported repeated CUDA kernel launch timeouts across 3 of 6 nodes around 13:38 PST; kernel traces show elevated kernel latency rather than immediate OOM.
- KV-cache miss rate spiked ~x8 coincident with elevated p50/p95; redis connection retries increased, exacerbating tail latency.
- No recent Redwood infra deploys in that cluster; we do see a Borealis-side autoscaler event around 13:35 that removed 2 nodes rapidly.

Immediate mitigations suggested:
- Re-instate the 2 nodes that were scaled down by the customer's autoscaler (if they can), or we can temporarily route ~20% of traffic to a warmed dedicated burst pool on our Dedicated fabric (requires exec OK for capacity bump).
- Apply a KV-cache warmshot (small synthetic requests to prime prefixes) to bring miss-rate down; attaching a sample warmshot image (kv-cache-warmshot.png).
- Disable the new prefix-splitting routing (if enabled) — the routing policy combined with the autoscaler change amplified prefix misses.

Actionable asks:
- Aditya: can you coordinate a temporary routing change to route fallback traffic to a warmed pool (15–30 min). If we need to spin extra capacity, I need a quick OK from product/ops to use burst capacity.
- Lauren/Vanessa: please confirm whether we should offer a 10% credit for the hour of degraded service if we take >30 minutes to restore.

I’ll keep digging into kernel traces (kernel log is attached as borealis_error_snippet.txt). If this is a pattern of autoscaler-induced node removal + cache miss, the short-term mitigation is routing + cache warm, medium-term is autoscaler guardrails.

— Jonas Weber
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Exec summary / ask: Borealis VPC incident (15:03 huddle requested)

Team — draft executive summary I will send to Borealis and leadership in a moment (attaching a short PDF). High-level to include in the huddle:
- Impact: production rerank pipeline degraded ~60% throughput, p95 latency doubled, customer reports elevated 5xxs; root-cause suspected to be rapid autoscaler node removal that interacted poorly with our routing/prefixing and caused KV-cache miss storm.
- Immediate remediation we propose (we plan to start now):
  * Temporary route 20% traffic to warmed dedicated burst pool (requires capacity bump + billing approval).
  * Run KV-cache warmshot across hot prefixes (5–10 min).
  * Request that Borealis pause autoscaler for 30 min.
- Ask: internal approval to use up to 2x burst VMs for 45 minutes (we will log and bill to emergency buffer) and approval to offer a one-hour 10% service credit to Borealis if restore >30 min.

If there’s no objection, I’ll run the huddle at 15:15 PST with the customer on the line. Please reply in-thread with quick thumbs (OK / need more info).

— Lauren
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Ethan Li <ethan.li@borealis.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@borealis.ai>, ops@borealis.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 17:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Borealis VPC: sudden throughput collapse and 5xx spike — requesting exec sync

Lauren / team — thanks for the rapid triage and proposed plan. We’ve paused our autoscaler (confirmation sent), and Sophie will stay on the call at 15:15 PST. Quick asks from our side:
- ETA for routing change and cache warmshot? (we need an approximate time to pass to product).
- If you need us to temporarily allow elevated network egress to route to Redwood Dedicated pool, confirm the IP ranges.

We appreciate the fast response — please let us know if you need anything else.

Ethan
Head of Platform Engineering | Borealis AI
